artifact.name: percentage_change_with_direction
artifact.content:
local function round2(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
	end

	local pct = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local direction: string

	if current > initial then
		direction = "up"
	elseif current < initial then
		direction = "down"
	else
		direction = "flat"
	end

	return {
		percentage_change = round2(pct),
		direction = direction,
	}
end
artifact.description: Computes rounded percentage change and direction between two numbers.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need to compare an initial and current value and report percent change plus up/down/flat direction.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	if not listed.ok then
		-- listed is a ToolError when ok == false
		return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
	end

	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}
	local sent = 0

	for _, customer in listed.customers do
		if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sent >= 10 then
				break
			end
			local text = "Hi " .. customer.name .. ", we miss you!"
			local res = tools.message.send({ user = customer.id, text = text })
			sent += 1
			if not res.ok then
				-- res is a ToolError when ok == false
				table.insert(failed, customer.id)
			else
				table.insert(notified, customer.id)
			end
		end
	end

	return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
artifact.description: Lists a CRM segment and messages inactive customers, tracking successes and failures.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_customers
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not listed.ok then
        return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
    end

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sent = 0
    local limit = 10
    local customers = listed.customers

    for _, customer in customers do
        if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if sent >= limit then
                failed[#failed + 1] = customer.id
                continue
            end

            local text = "Hi " .. customer.name .. ", we miss you!"
            local result = tools.message.send({ user = customer.id, text = text })
            if not result.ok then
                failed[#failed + 1] = customer.id
            else
                notified[#notified + 1] = customer.id
                sent += 1
            end
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
